Ravi (Solutions): FYI Acme sent a follow-up: they want an "evidence manifest" for our KMS + RBAC + incident timelines. Review call tomorrow 10:30am. Need a concise deliverable list.
Elaine (Sec): Ok. Suggested bundle: 1) KMS key lifecycle logs (create, rotate, rewrap, destroy), 2) envelope encryption architecture doc, 3) role->permission CSV + role-change audit, 4) two IR playbooks and executed traces, 5) CVE triage timeline examples.
Sam (Eng): For RBAC we can export JSON role definitions and a CSV of recent grants. We also have ephemeral lease TTLs implemented; TTLs are 15m for short-lived API tokens, 1h for interactive sessions, and 5m-1h for service creds depending on scope.
Jordan (Infra): I'll pull audit logs from both AWS CloudTrail and GCP Cloud Audit. Sample AWS CLI filter: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=ScheduleKeyDeletion --start-time 2024-01-01 --end-time 2025-01-01 --max-results 50`. For GCP sample: `gcloud logging read 'logName="projects/REDACTED/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access" AND protoPayload.methodName:"DestroyCryptoKeyVersion"' --limit 50`.
Jordan (Infra): Redacted log snippet we can paste (sanitized):
```
{ protoPayload: { methodName: "v1.cryptoKeys.destroy", resourceName: "projects/REDACTED/locations/global/keyRings/rr/keyRings/rr-key/cryptoKeys/rr-cmk", authenticationInfo: { principalEmail: "service-account@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com" } }, timestamp: "2024-09-02T14:23:01Z" }
```
Elaine (Sec): Note: include hashing approach for ID redaction (SHA256 with salt) and state that we can supply a mapping under NDA. Priya, legal signoff needed for hashed->clear mapping.
Priya (Legal): Confirmed. We'll prepare an NDA addendum template and approve hashed IDs. We will not share raw PII without signed agreement.
Alex (SRE): For incident response examples, suggest we use 1) a misconfiguration that caused model requests to leak debug headers (sanitized) and 2) a latency-induced failover where we routed to fallback models. Provide timeline, pager alerts, and postmortem summary (redacted).
Sam (Eng): Add mitigations we can do while patching: immediate key rotation for affected assets, temporary token revocation, feature-flag disable, model routing changes, and IP allowlisting for dedicated customers.
Ravi (Solutions): Also they asked for retention periods: our default logging retention is 7 years for audit logs, 90 days for debug-level traces, configurable for Private deployments. Call this out.
Elaine (Sec): I'll draft the KMS evidence snippet: "Redwood uses envelope encryption. CMKs are rotated annually; DEKs are generated per-asset and rewrapped on CMK rotation. All key-state transitions (CREATE, ENABLE, DISABLE, SCHEDULE_DESTROY, DESTROY) are recorded in the audit trail with immutable timestamps."
Jordan (Infra): I'll attach export commands and a small sanitized CSV example `service_account,role,granted_at,actor` for RBAC. Also include a short flow diagram (PNG) for issuance + rewrap.
Priya (Legal): Reminder: mark all files Confidential — Customer Acme. We'll supply the NDA addendum and mapping under separate secure channel.
Elaine (Sec): On CVE process: triage within 1 business day, assign severity (CVSS) within 2 days, mitigation plan within 5 business days, and target patch/rollback depends on severity and customer impact. Will include two historical examples with dates and timelines.
Ravi (Solutions): Who's joining the call? Elaine + Jordan + Alex + Priya. Sam optional. I'll send calendar invite and attach the latest questionnaire PDF.
sec-bot: Checklist generated: [x] KMS logs export sample, [x] RBAC CSV sample, [ ] IR traces redacted, [x] TTL table, [ ] NDA addendum draft.
Elaine (Sec): Aiming to post first-draft bundle to the secure dropbox by EOD. Ping here when uploads are ready for final review.
Priya (Legal): I'll review redaction approach once the draft is uploaded.
Ravi (Solutions): Thanks team. Quick action items: Jordan (KMS exports + commands), Elaine (KMS + RBAC snippets), Alex (IR traces + playbooks), Sam (mitigations + TTL table), Priya (NDA).
